analytic_proof_obligations: canonical Hamilton equations and contact bracket
left-translation propagation of the identity cut locus

convention.manifold: standard real Heisenberg H^1 in coordinates (x,y,z)
convention.metric: X,Y orthonormal; all displayed geodesics have unit speed

distance_contract.maxwell_boundary: theta approaches sign(z)*pi and the endpoint loses the angle phi

exponential_contract.first_positive_zero: s=2*pi; the first positive tan(s/2)=s/2 root is later
exponential_contract.parameters: initial horizontal norm r, angle phi, vertical momentum lambda, time t

nonclaims: No result is asserted for arbitrary Carnot groups.
The sub-Riemannian Hamiltonian is not a target Hilbert--Polya operator.

proof_contract.abnormal: no nonconstant abnormal extremals because a covector annihilating X,Y and [X,Y] must vanish
proof_contract.complete_geodesics: there are no nontrivial closed complete geodesics: lambda=0 gives lines, while lambda!=0 has nonzero vertical drift per horizontal period
proof_contract.minimality: horizontal length equals planar length and z is signed planar area; the unique sub-full-turn Dido arcs and full circles give the stated minimizers
proof_contract.scope: only standard H^1; no theorem for arbitrary Carnot groups
proof_contract.uniqueness_before_cut: the implicit-angle function is strictly increasing on (-pi,pi)

source.author: Bernard Gaveau
source.role: primary classical lineage for the nilpotent sub-Riemannian model
source.title: Principe de moindre action, propagation de la chaleur et estimees sous elliptiques sur certains groupes nilpotents

trajectory_contract.lambda_nonzero: x=(sin(phi+lambda t)-sin(phi))/lambda; y=(cos(phi)-cos(phi+lambda t))/lambda; z=(lambda t-sin(lambda t))/(2 lambda^2)
